about: Riding spots. Every parking entry must come from an official source (Forest Service or DNR) or from 2+ independent sources that agree. src: usfs = Forest Service recreation site id, dnr = DNR recreation site name, multi = several sources agree.

spots.name: Devils Gulch Trailhead
spots.area: Mission Creek Rd, south of Cashmere
spots.trails: Devils Gulch #1220, lower Mission Ridge #1201, Red Devil #1221, Red Hill #1223
spots.notes: Closest motorcycle trail system to Wenatchee. Upper Red Hill closes Oct 15 – Jun 15 for elk calving; the rest stays open but gets snow up high in winter.
spots.pass: $5/day fee or Northwest Forest Pass, plus ORV tag

parking.name: Devils Gulch ORV Trailhead
parking.road: On Mission Creek Rd, about 10 miles south of Cashmere.

spots.name: Upper Devils Gulch / Beehive (via Squilchuck Rd)
spots.seasonNote: Snow usually blocks the road Nov – May
spots.trails: Upper Devils Gulch #1220, Beehive #1202 (beginner), Devils Spur #1203, Mission Ridge #1201 nearby
spots.notes: The quick way into Devils Gulch from Wenatchee. Drive up Squilchuck Rd toward Mission Ridge, go 1 mile past Squilchuck State Park, turn right on FR 9712 (Beehive Reservoir Rd), and drive about 4.3 miles. Devils Spur #1203 runs from FR 9712 down toward Squilchuck Rd. Squilchuck Rd itself is street-legal only, so trailer the bike to the trailhead.
spots.pass: No fee at the upper trailheads. ORV tag required.

parking.name: Upper Devils Gulch ORV Trailhead
parking.road: From Squilchuck Rd, 1 mile past Squilchuck State Park turn right on FR 9712 (Beehive Reservoir Rd), then about 4.3 miles. No fee.

parking.name: Beehive ORV Trailhead
parking.road: At Beehive Reservoir on FR 9712, just past the Upper Devils Gulch lot.

spots.name: Mission Ridge Trailhead
spots.area: FR 9712 off Squilchuck Rd, below Mission Peak
spots.seasonNote: High elevation. Snow usually blocks the road Nov – May
spots.trails: Mission Ridge #1201 (rated advanced). The trail starts right at this trailhead.
spots.notes: Upper end of Mission Ridge #1201. Mission Peak is about 1.5 miles south. Not the ski area lot.
spots.pass: No fee at the upper trailheads. ORV tag required.

parking.name: Mission Ridge Trailhead
parking.road: Same route as Upper Devils Gulch: Squilchuck Rd, then right on FR 9712 past Squilchuck State Park. Mission Ridge Trailhead is about 1.9 miles past the Upper Devils Gulch lot, a little over 2 miles past Beehive Reservoir. Past the reservoir FR 9712 is a dirt road for high-clearance vehicles.

spots.name: Tronsen Ridge
spots.seasonNote: Closed Oct 15 – Jun 15 for elk calving
spots.notes: Ridge riding with big views. Three trailheads, so you can start from either end.

parking.name: Upper Tronsen Ridge ORV Trailhead
parking.road: No fee.

parking.name: Tronsen Ridge ORV Trailhead
parking.road: Near Blewett Pass.

parking.name: Ruby Creek ORV Trailhead (north end)
parking.road: North end of Tronsen Ridge #1204.

spots.name: Mad River Trails
spots.seasonNote: Usually under snow Nov – June. Upper Mad River and Blue Creek open only when posted
spots.trails: Mad River #1409, Upper Mad River #1409.1, Blue Creek #1426, Devils Backbone #1448
spots.notes: Big single-track network maintained mainly for motorcycles and mountain bikes.
spots.pass: $5/day fee or Northwest Forest Pass, plus ORV tag

parking.name: Mad River Trailhead - Lower
parking.road: Bring cash or a check for the day fee.

parking.name: Mad River Trailhead - Upper
parking.road: Upper Mad River and side trails.

spots.name: Chiwawa / Alder Ridge ORV Trails
spots.area: Chiwawa River Rd, north of Lake Wenatchee
spots.seasonNote: Alder Ridge and Upper Chikamin close each spring and open only when posted
spots.trails: Lower Chiwawa #1548, Minnow Ridge #1524, Chikamin Creek #1534, Alder Ridge #1523, Chikamin Tie #1561
spots.notes: Several ORV trails maintained for motorcycles. Goose Creek Campground nearby is a common motorcycle base.

parking.name: Chikamin ORV Trailhead
parking.road: Minnow Ridge, Chikamin Creek and Lower Chiwawa trails.

parking.name: Alder Ridge ORV Trailhead
parking.road: Alder Ridge #1523.

parking.name: Chikamin Tie ORV Trailhead
parking.road: Chikamin Tie #1561 to the Upper Mad River area.

spots.name: Stemilt / Colockum Green Dot Roads (Clear Lake)
spots.area: Stemilt Loop Rd, south of Wenatchee
spots.seasonNote: Seasonal green-dot roads close Mar 1 – Apr 15. In winter these lots are Sno-Parks for snowmobiles (Sno-Park permit required)
spots.trails: Green-dot roads: Lilly Lake Rd, Upper Basin Loop, Orr Creek Rd, Jumpoff Rd, Pole Flat Rd, Ingersoll Rd, Naneum Ridge Rd and more
spots.notes: Dirt roads, not single track. Ride only roads with green-dot markers (green on the map). Stemilt Loop Rd, Upper Wheeler Rd and parts of Colockum Rd are street-legal only (gray-blue on the map), so a non-plated bike can't ride them.
spots.pass: Discover Pass + ORV tag (Sno-Park permit in winter)

parking.name: Clear Lake Sno-Park
parking.road: Malaga Hwy south of Wenatchee, right on Stemilt Creek Rd, right on Stemilt Loop Rd for 3 miles to Clear Lake Rd. 125 spaces.

parking.name: Lily Lake Sno-Park
parking.road: Stemilt Loop Rd for 4.5 miles to Lily Lake Rd; lot entrance about 200 ft east of the junction on the left. 40 spaces.

spots.name: Naneum Ridge State Forest
spots.area: South of Wenatchee via Colockum / Naneum
spots.seasonNote: Some green-dot roads close Mar 1 – Apr 15. Snow trails groomed for sleds Dec 15 – Apr 1
spots.trails: 109 miles of green-dot roads (dirt roads, not single track)
spots.notes: Ride only roads with green-dot markers (green on the map). Some roads are street-legal only (gray-blue on the map). Active logging in the Coleman and Stemilt areas through Oct 2026.
spots.noParking: DNR doesn't list a motorized trailhead here. People use pullouts along green-dot roads. Use the DNR green dot map to plan.

spots.name: Taneum / Manastash Trails
spots.seasonNote: Spring closure until about June 15; snow late fall
spots.trails: South Fork Taneum #1367, North Fork Taneum #1377, Manastash Ridge #1388, Taneum Ridge #1363
spots.notes: Large motorcycle trail network. Icewater Creek Campground has a beginner motorcycle loop (campground is closed for the season now).
spots.pass: $5/day fee or Northwest Forest Pass, plus ORV tag. Discover Pass is not valid here.

parking.name: South Fork Meadow Trailhead
parking.road: South Fork Taneum #1367.

parking.name: Manastash Trailhead
parking.road: Manastash Ridge #1388. Fee tubes at Manastash Camp.

spots.name: Little Naches OHV Area
spots.seasonNote: Spring closure until about June 15; campgrounds close in fall
spots.trails: Single track leaving right from the campgrounds
spots.notes: Popular motorcycle area with OHV staging and campgrounds next to the trails. Farther drive (about 2.5 hours).
spots.pass: Staging fee or Northwest Forest Pass, plus ORV tag

parking.name: Longmire Meadow OHV staging
parking.road: OHV staging area with vault toilet.

parking.name: Kaner Flat Campground
parking.road: Campground with RV loop.

spots.name: Moses Lake Sand Dunes
spots.area: Grant County ORV area, south of Moses Lake
spots.notes: Best winter option. No alcohol allowed. A paddle tire helps. Don't ride on county or canal roads.

parking.name: Dune entrance, Sand Dune Rd
parking.srcNote: 3 separate sources agree within 50 m (Timber Tamers club, Campendium, Overland Bound)
parking.road: Park along the gravel road. Parking is on sand, so watch for soft spots. 2026: the Hansen Rd overpass at I-90 Exit 174 is closed; use Exit 169 if coming from the east.

spots.name: Beverly Dunes ORV Area
spots.area: Lower Crab Creek Rd, near Beverly
spots.trails: About 300 acres of sandy trails and bowls
spots.notes: Smaller and quieter than Moses Lake. Good for all ages.

parking.name: Beverly Dunes ORV Area (DNR)
parking.road: Off Lower Crab Creek Rd, about 2 miles east of the Hwy 243 turn. Staging area is on the south side.

spots.name: Mitchell Creek ATV/ORV Loop
spots.area: Grade Creek Rd (FS 8200), south shore of Lake Chelan
spots.seasonNote: Forest roads; usually snow-free June – October
spots.trails: FS road 8200-112 and FS 8215 (East Fork Mitchell Rd) loop, plus a short link on FS 8200
spots.notes: A Forest Service ATV/ORV route on forest roads, not single track. ORVs are allowed only on the loop roads (FS 8200-112 and FS 8215) and the short connecting section of FS 8200. The map draws FS 8215; FS 8200-112 isn't in the Forest Service road data, so follow the signs for that part.

parking.name: Loop start, FS 8200 Grade Creek Rd
parking.road: Forest Service map point for the route start. There's no developed lot, so pull fully off the road where it's safe.

spots.name: Foggy Dew / Crater Creek (Methow)
spots.area: Gold Creek area, south of Carlton
spots.seasonNote: High country; usually snow-free mid-June through October
spots.trails: Foggy Dew #417, Navarre Way #424, Crater Creek #416, Martin Creek #429, Eagle Lakes #431
spots.notes: Single track in the Sawtooth backcountry. The Forest Service says some trails here are closed to motorcycles, so check the Sawtooth Backcountry trail brochure before you go.
spots.pass: $5/day fee or Northwest Forest Pass, plus ORV tag

parking.name: Foggy Dew Trailhead
parking.road: Foggy Dew #417 and Navarre Way #424.

parking.name: Crater Creek Trailhead
parking.road: Crater Creek #416, Martin Lakes #429, Eagle Lakes #431. Too narrow for 4-wheelers.

spots.name: Ahtanum State Forest
spots.area: West of Yakima via Ahtanum Rd and Middle Fork Rd (A-2000)
spots.seasonNote: Snowmobile area in winter; wheeled riding usually from about May 1
spots.trails: Green-dot roads and trails off Red Saddle and Ahtanum Meadows
spots.notes: DNR forest with green-dot roads open to ORVs and motorcycles. About 2.5 hours from Wenatchee.

parking.name: Red Saddle Trailhead
parking.road: From Union Gap take Ahtanum Rd west to Tampico, then Middle Fork Rd (A-2000) about 9.5 miles.

parking.name: Ahtanum Meadows Campground
parking.road: 6-site campground on Middle Fork Rd (A-2000).

spots.name: Reiter Foothills ORV Area
spots.seasonNote: Check the DNR page for hours and closures
spots.trails: Motorized trail system on DNR land
spots.notes: Popular west-side ORV and motorcycle area. About 2 hours from Wenatchee over Stevens Pass.

parking.name: Reiter Foothills Motorized P1
parking.road: From Gold Bar east on Hwy 2, left on Reiter Rd, stay right at the fork after 1 mile, left after 3.2 miles onto Deer Flats Rd to the marked lots.

parking.name: Reiter Foothills Motorized P2
parking.road: Second motorized lot on Deer Flats Rd.

spots.name: Walker Valley ORV Area
spots.seasonNote: Check the DNR page for hours and closures
spots.trails: Motorized trail system on DNR land
spots.notes: Large west-side ORV and motorcycle trail system. About 3.5 hours from Wenatchee.

parking.name: Walker Valley ORV Trailhead
parking.road: DNR official site.

spots.name: Elbe Hills ORV Area
spots.notes: DNR ORV area near Mount Rainier. Reservations are required. About 3.5 hours from Wenatchee.

parking.name: Elbe Hills ORV Trailhead
parking.road: From Elbe east on SR-706 about 6.1 miles, left on 278th Ave E, west on DNR 8 Rd for 2.5 miles to the 8/92 junction, left 0.1 mile.
